rows.name: The Great Sage knew with his power that you would come-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]He already knows what you want to ask-mo. "Where is this place, and who are you?" Right-mo?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:sel sel=・What is this place?/・Who are you? ]

It seems like the Giant God Realm, yet isn't. Familiar, yet unknown. A place tying past to future-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And the Nopon Great Sage is a great Nopon who attained that title by training across all space and time-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

The Nopon Great Sage is a great Nopon who trained in every place and time until he became the Great Sage-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Training his disciples is also the Nopon Great Sage's duty-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:sel sel=・What is this place?/・Who are you?/・Disciple? ]

Since you've come here, you're disciples of the Great Sage-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]The Great Sage also knows that both reward and punishment are important when raising disciples-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:sel sel=・Tell us about the carrot/・Tell us about the stick ]

Since you've come here, you're disciples of the Great Sage-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]If you do well on the challenges he gives you, you'll receive rewards-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]If the Great Sage hadn't cast aside worldly desire, these are treasures he'd never be able to part with-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

You'll take on challenges set by the Great Sage-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Show him how quickly you can defeat the enemies standing in your way-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:sel sel=・We'll become your disciples/・We want to go home ]
[XENO:type type=anger ]You're every bit as capable as the Nopon Great Sage expected-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

By the way, if more of your companions want to become disciples, bring them here-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]The Great Sage will prepare other challenges and rewards-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
I'll prepare other challenges and rewards for later too-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

The Great Sage knows that too-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]You have another important mission-mo. Approach the light behind you and you'll return to your own world-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
